description: Wire the base-URL smoke suite as a post-deploy gate so a deploy that produces a 404-on-everything stack fails loudly. There is currently NO deploy workflow (only verify.yml); the epic sequences the actual AWS/deploy pipelines much later (Phase 7, #288/#289). So deliver the callable HOOK plus documentation, not a fake deploy pipeline: add a reusable GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml) that a future deploy job can call via workflow_call and that a human can trigger via workflow_dispatch, passing the target redirect base URL and API base URL (and, if needed, a smoke user email/password or the note that open registration is used). The workflow runs scripts/smoke-redirect.sh against the target and fails the job (non-zero) if any assertion fails, so 'a deploy is not successful until it passes'. Also document the env contract + this wiring in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md so Phase 7 knows exactly how to call it. Must not dump the environment; reference only the specific vars each step needs.
steps: Create .github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml. Triggers: `workflow_call` (with inputs and optional secrets, so a future deploy workflow can `uses:` it as a post-deploy gate) AND `workflow_dispatch` (so an operator can run it by hand against a URL). Set permissions: contents: read.

Define inputs: redirect_base_url (required string, maps to RD), api_base_url (required string, maps to API), link_domain (optional string, maps to LINK_DOMAIN; when omitted the script derives it from RD). For credentials use optional secrets smoke_email / smoke_password (mapped to SMOKE_EMAIL/SMOKE_PASSWORD) with a comment that they are only needed when the deployed environment has open registration disabled; by default the script self-registers a throwaway user.

Job steps: actions/checkout@v4; pnpm/action-setup@v4; actions/setup-node@v4 with node-version 22 (node is needed only for the script's node -pe JSON parsing; no pnpm install required because the script uses only curl + node). Then a single run step: `bash scripts/smoke-redirect.sh`, passing env: RD from inputs.redirect_base_url, API from inputs.api_base_url, LINK_DOMAIN from inputs.link_domain, and SMOKE_EMAIL/SMOKE_PASSWORD from the optional secrets. The step must NOT echo/printenv/set/export -p or otherwise dump the environment; reference only these named vars. Because the script exits non-zero on any failed assertion, the job fails and thus gates the deploy.

Do NOT set DATABASE_URL in this workflow: a deployed target has no direct DB access, so the script must run in its API-only (deployed) mode and rely on the always-run API analytics country-population check (FEAT-001). Add a comment stating this.

Add a comment block at the top of smoke-deployed.yml explaining: this is the post-deploy gate hook; today no deploy workflow calls it because the AWS/deploy pipeline is sequenced for Phase 7 (#288/#289); a Phase 7 deploy job wires it as a dependent job (needs: deploy) via `uses: ./.github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml` with the freshly-deployed URLs, so the deploy is not considered successful until this passes. Note it can only be fully exercised once a real deploy target exists.

Update docs/DEPLOYMENT.md: add a short section (e.g. under Backend -> AWS or a new 'Post-deploy smoke gate' heading) documenting (a) the env contract for scripts/smoke-redirect.sh (API, RD, LINK_DOMAIN and its DEFAULT_DOMAIN alignment requirement, optional SMOKE_EMAIL/SMOKE_PASSWORD), (b) how to run it by hand against a deployed URL, (c) that .github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml is the reusable hook a Phase 7 deploy job calls so a 404-on-everything deploy fails loudly, and (d) that in deployed mode the DB-backed assertions are skipped and country population is verified through GET /analytics instead.

Validate the workflow YAML parses (e.g. python3 -c 'import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open("..."))' or an equivalent available parser) and re-check that verify.yml is untouched. Confirm no env-dump commands were introduced.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml exists, is valid YAML, has both workflow_call and workflow_dispatch triggers, permissions contents: read, and inputs for redirect_base_url + api_base_url (+ optional link_domain and smoke_email/smoke_password secrets).

The workflow runs `bash scripts/smoke-redirect.sh` with RD/API (and optional LINK_DOMAIN, SMOKE_EMAIL/SMOKE_PASSWORD) sourced from its inputs/secrets, and the job fails when the script exits non-zero (so it gates a deploy).
The workflow does NOT set DATABASE_URL (deployed mode) and contains no environment-dumping commands (no env/printenv/set/export -p/process.env dumps).

A top-of-file comment explains it is the post-deploy gate hook, that Phase 7 (#288/#289) will wire it via `needs: deploy` + `uses:`, and that it can only be fully exercised once a deploy target exists.
docs/DEPLOYMENT.md documents the env contract, the manual invocation, the reusable-hook wiring, and the deployed-mode DB-skip + analytics country verification.
verification: Parse .github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml as YAML and confirm triggers/inputs/permissions
grep the new workflow for forbidden env-dump patterns (env, printenv, set -x-only-is-fine-but-no-dump, export -p) and confirm none are present as env dumps
git diff --stat confirms verify.yml is not modified by this feature
Read docs/DEPLOYMENT.md changes and confirm the env contract + hook wiring + deployed-mode notes are present
findings: Added .github/workflows/smoke-deployed.yml (reusable workflow_call + workflow_dispatch, permissions contents:read, inputs redirect_base_url/api_base_url/link_domain, optional secrets smoke_email/smoke_password). It runs `bash scripts/smoke-redirect.sh` with RD/API/LINK_DOMAIN from inputs and SMOKE_EMAIL/SMOKE_PASSWORD from secrets; no pnpm install (script uses only curl + node -pe). Deliberately sets NO DATABASE_URL so the script runs in API-only deployed mode (documented in a comment); the word DATABASE_URL appears only inside that explanatory comment, not as an assignment. Top-of-file comment explains Phase 7 (#288/#289) will wire it via needs: deploy + uses:. YAML validated with PyYAML (installed via pip under OPEN_INTERNET): triggers, inputs (redirect_base_url/api_base_url required, link_domain optional), secrets, and permissions all parse as intended. Checked for env-dump patterns (printenv/export -p/process.env/bare env/set -x): none present. verify.yml is unchanged (git diff --stat shows only docs/DEPLOYMENT.md modified + new workflow untracked). docs/DEPLOYMENT.md gained a 'Post-deploy smoke gate' section covering the env contract (API/RD/LINK_DOMAIN + DEFAULT_DOMAIN alignment, optional SMOKE_EMAIL/SMOKE_PASSWORD), manual invocation, the reusable-hook wiring, and the deployed-mode DB-skip + analytics country verification. Did NOT modify scripts/smoke-redirect.sh (FEAT-001, already complete). No app code touched, so pnpm build/test not required per the docs-only guidance; the full deployed run can only be exercised once a Phase 7 deploy target exists.
